usageNotes: Returns the API directory index for a specific node under a PDM-registered PVE remote — use it to discover which child endpoints are available for that node (e.g. guests, storage, tasks). Both the remote name and the node name must already exist in PDM; the node name matches the Proxmox cluster node name (not a hostname). The response type is null in the schema because PDM returns a list of child endpoint descriptors rather than structured node data.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for node 'pve1' on remote 'hetzner-prod'

tips: The node name must match exactly as registered in the PVE cluster — check get_pve_remotes_remote_nodes for valid node names under a remote.
This is a directory index; the useful data lives in child endpoints (guests, tasks, etc.), not in this response itself.
API tokens are accepted (allowtoken: true), so service-account tokens with minimal scope work fine for this read-only call.
